text:
When a queued request's reading is refused for the same reason on consecutive reads, for example 'relies on repo paths that are not in the snapshot' (reading.rs), stop re-reading it. Mark it as needing rewording, with the refusal reason recorded, and move on to the next item so it no longer blocks the queue. Acceptance: (1) a test queues a request that names a path missing from the snapshot, ahead of a valid request; after at most 2 refused reads the stale item is set aside with its reason recorded, and the valid request is read and dispatched; (2) the set-aside item stays visible in the queue listing with its refusal reason; (3) cargo test, clippy and fmt pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: A queued request that names a file that was later split was refused at every reading (8 reader runs) and held up about 40 queued items until the the person running Athena closed it
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: reading.rs
